        json
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/nlohmann/json.git
        GIT_TAG v3.11.2
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(json)

# Create library target
add_library(TelegramBotAPI_Models STATIC
    ${TELEGRAM_MODELS_SOURCES}
)

target_include_directories(TelegramBotAPI_Models
    PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

target_link_libraries(TelegramBotAPI_Models
    PUBLIC
        nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
)

# Install rules (optional)
install(TARGETS TelegramBotAPI_Models
    EXPORT TelegramBotAPI_ModelsTargets
    LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
    INCLUDES DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/telegram
)

install(FILES ${TELEGRAM_MODELS_HEADERS}
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/telegram
)

install(EXPORT TelegramBotAPI_ModelsTargets
    FILE TelegramBotAPI_ModelsTargets.cmake
    NAMESPACE TelegramBotAPI::
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/TelegramBotAPI_Models
)

# Usage in other projects:
#   add_subdirectory(path/to/telegram-api-generator/example/cpp)
#   target_link_libraries(your_target PRIVATE TelegramBotAPI_Models)
